definition: The placement of the component's coordinate frame within the coordinate frame of the assembly.  In STEP the equivalent is carried by an item_defined_transformation, which holds two axis2_placement_3d items (transform_item_1, in the component's own representation, and transform_item_2, in the assembly's); this property holds the net placement of the component in the assembly, i.e. it assumes transform_item_1 is the identity placement.
name: placement
